site.method: convergence of 3 independent sources: EIA-860M plant registration coords, Gobblers Knob USGS/gazetteer named-feature coords (31.5640,-98.8192, 0.6km away), and a GIS-precision project-boundary polygon in the Mills County Ch.312 abatement application overlaid on topo+aerial basemaps (NW Mills County, immediately east of the historic Camp Bowie tract, south of the Brown/Mills county line, between Brownwood and Goldthwaite) — all three converge on the same ~1-2 km neighborhood. IMAGERY-VERIFIED 2026-07-21: s2aws.py Sentinel-2 chips centered on the exact EIA-860M coordinate (31.568929,-98.82195, no offset) show a construction footprint whose distinctive arrow/quadrilateral outline (NW notch, narrow SE tail) matches the Ch.312 abatement application's project-boundary map exhibit feature-for-feature (sources/2026-07-20_millscountytx_red-river-abatement-applica_sheet04.png, panel 2) — confirms the EIA point and the map exhibit describe the same physical site without requiring formal pixel-level georeferencing. Cross-checked against data/eia_generator_tx.parquet (latest snapshot 2026-05-01): no other Brown County operating/UC plant is anywhere near this coordinate — nearest are IP Radian LLC (320MW operating solar+BESS, 31.5481,-99.1872, ~31km W) and Wetzel BESS (RIC Development, planned/not-approved, 31.7070,-98.8575, ~15km N), both far outside the 3.5km imagery buffer — visible construction is unambiguously Chisme, not a neighbor.
site.confidence: high (imagery-verified EIA coordinate — rung 3 of the map-exhibit>IA-Exhibit-C-text>imagery-verified-EIA>Places-pin hierarchy; IA Exhibit C's POI coordinates are redacted/blacked-out in the signed IA text, and the map exhibit's polygon was not formally georeferenced to lat/lon, so imagery-verified EIA is the highest rung actually achieved, though the map-exhibit shape match corroborates it strongly)

Not under construction' (2024-10 through 2026-03) to '(U) Under construction, less than or equal to 50 percent complete' (2026-04, 2026-05, most recent snapshot) — independent, non-visual, federally-reported confirmation that physical construction has begun

IMAGERY VERIFIED 2026-07-21 via s2aws.py (AWS Open Data/Earth Search STAC — no CDSE dependency; CDSE remains down this run, see below): 5 Sentinel-2 chips fetched at the exact EIA-860M coordinate (31.568929,-98.82195), 3.5km buffer. 2024-07-07 (18.9% cloud) and 2025-07-17 (8.6% cloud) are clean pre-construction baselines — undisturbed rangeland/woodland, no boundary or clearing visible. 2026-01-03 (0% cloud, leaf-off) is the FIRST frame showing the project's distinctive arrow-shaped perimeter access road plus tan/bare-soil disturbance in the central-to-southern interior — clearing/grading already underway ~3 months before EIA's formal '(U)' status flip (2026-04), consistent with site prep preceding the EIA reporting threshold. 2026-05-03 (0% cloud) shows the full site graded: complete perimeter + internal access-road network subdividing the site into blocks, and a light-toned staging/laydown area in the NW corner (likely substation/O&M pad) — civil-stage construction, matches the EIA status-flip month exactly. 2026-06-27 (3.1% cloud, most recent available) shows further-advanced grading covering nearly the entire interior plus an enlarged NW staging area with visible light-colored objects (equipment/materials) — civil works essentially complete; no individual panel rows are resolvable yet at Sentinel-2's 10m resolution, so racking/panel-installation progress could not be confirmed or ruled out from this imagery alone.

Boundary shape cross-check: the imagery footprint's outline (NW notch, narrow SE tail) matches the Ch.312 abatement application's 'Project Boundary' map exhibit feature-for-feature (sources/2026-07-20_millscountytx_red-river-abatement-applica_sheet04.png panel 2) — independent confirmation the constructed footprint is the filed Chisme project, not a different development.

Neighbor cross-check (data/eia_generator_tx.parquet, latest snapshot 2026-05-01, Brown County rows): only Chisme Solar and Storage (plant 68078) sits at this coordinate; the only other Brown County entries are IP Radian LLC (320MW operating solar+BESS, 31.5481,-99.1872, ~31km W — far outside the imagery frame) and Wetzel BESS (RIC Development, '(P) Planned, regulatory approvals not initiated', 31.7070,-98.8575, ~15km N — also outside the frame and not yet under construction regardless) — no risk of attributing a neighbor's development to Chisme.
